runner: run_lerobot_libero.py (LeRobot policy, processors, LIBERO env and rollout loop)
max_steps: episode_lengths per suite if set, else --env.episode_length in the extra flags if set, else LeRobot defaults (spatial 280, object 280, goal 300, libero_10 520)
note: Third-party checkpoint zuoxingdong/evo1_libero (Xingdong Zuo, trained with LeRobot's two-stage EVO1 recipe), not the Evo-1 authors' MINT-SJTU/Evo1_LIBERO (which needs their own server). Flags exactly as the lerobot-eval command of its model card, whose protocol is ours (seed 1000, initial states 0-49, step limits 280/280/300/520): replan every 14 actions, 32 denoising steps, 448 px, bf16 VLM, no flash-attn, gripper binarized at 0. Model card: 485/496/483/469 = 96.65%. LeRobot commit 30da8e68 (2026-07-06) instead of the card's e40b58a8 (2026-07-08). InternVL3-1B-hf read from a local folder.
policy_settings: as stored in the checkpoint (policy_config.json) unless overridden by the extra flags
